attributes.name: Gift of Nocticula
attributes.powers:
Display this card next to the scenario; the barrier is defeated. If another barrier is next to the scenario, banish 1 of them.

While displayed, after you roll the dice on any check, you may uncheck 1 skill feat to add 1d20 to that check. (If the skill has multiple adjacent checked boxes, the one you uncheck must be the farthest to the right.) Then banish this card.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barrier Gift of Nocticula, replace "you may uncheck 1 skill feat to add 1d20 to that check, then banish this card" with "you may uncheck 1 skill feat to add 1d20 to that check. (If the skill has multiple adjacent checked boxes, the one you uncheck must be the farthest to the right.) Then banish this card".
corrections.issue: To use Gift of Nocticula, I have to uncheck a skill feat. I have "+1" and "+2" checked on one of my skills. Can I just uncheck the "+1"?
